name: Demo Stage
description: Deploy static sites and demos to demo.st from Claude Code. Reserve a subdomain, upload a zip of your build, and get a live link like yourproject.demo.st. Includes a deploy subagent that knows the workflow and the demo.st MCP server (set DEMO_ST_MCP_TOKEN after signing in at demo.st). Use it for prototypes, frontend builds, or sharing demos.
longDescription:
Ships **1 agent**, `deploy` (Deploy static sites and demos to demo.st) and **1 MCP server**, `demo-st`.

Installs with `claude plugin install demo-stage@claude-community` from `demo-stage/demo.st-Claude`.

A Claude Code plugin that adds a deploy subagent and the demo.st MCP server. Use it to deploy static sites and demos to demo.st: reserve a subdomain, upload a zip, get a live link like `yourproject.demo.st`.
